description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeGatewaySync component in the VoiceWakePreferences module, primarily testing JSON decoding of trigger words.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGatewaySyncTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for VoiceWakePreferences decoding functions related to gateway triggers.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONSanitizes
methods.description: Tests that JSON payload with various triggers is sanitized correctly, removing whitespace and empty strings.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONFallsBackWhenEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that when triggers are empty strings, default trigger words are used.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromInvalidJSONReturnsNil
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input results in a nil trigger list.
